# Cortex plan-first retrieval: a deterministic corpus contract + plan-family-first retrieval

**Status:** [WIP] (the PLAN AMENDMENT RECORD A9 compaction; the workstream is NOT closed - the Phase-2 obligations are live)

**Trigger phrases:** cortex plan-first retrieval, plan-first ranking, plan family filter, CSV family filter, corpus family contract, generated README exclusion, rag:update bounded memory, plan-first corpus.

**Tracker:** `plans/cortex-plan-first-retrieval.plans.md` (this file). **Lane:** Standalone Meta-Workflow Lane (cross-cutting tooling). **Scope shape:** 2 phases, 7 steps, 25 slices, no implementation in this authoring pass.

---

## Scope

**IN (this plan, exactly as settled):**

1. A deterministic corpus-family contract for the Cortex RAG index: one published source of truth, one target family set.
2. The exclusion of the GENERATED `src/**/README.md` (173 docs) and the GENERATED example READMEs (58 docs) from the indexed corpus, plus the exclusion of the 20.9 MB generated session snapshot.
3. The PRESERVATION of the handwritten documentation (the `root-doc` family plus the 13 handwritten example READMEs) and of EVERY plan / completed-plan tracker, INCLUDING the `.logs.md` trackers - **no new log family is introduced**.
4. The RECLASSIFICATION of the existing demo and benchmark TEST documents only (the 317 `examples/**/*.test.ts` files and the 22 `benchmarks/**/*.test.ts` files) into one `test` family. No test is authored, deleted or rewritten by this reclassification.
5. The plan-first RETRIEVAL: the CSV family filter (`plan,completed-plan`) must reach the SQL as a set filter, and the plan families must rank first.
6. A bounded-memory `npm run rag:update`: the corpus change must not increase the peak heap / peak RSS of the pipeline, and must not increase the indexed corpus bytes or the replica size. RESTATED BY PLAN AMENDMENT RECORD A5 - the peak-RSS half of this item is bounded by ONE hard MUST-NOT-EXCEED: the post-change peak RSS is the MEDIAN of N >= 5 runs of the SAME probe against the POST-change corpus, and that MEDIAN MUST NOT exceed the ORIGINALLY FROZEN ceiling of 585,711,616 bytes. There is NO allowance of any kind - no percentage, no tolerance band, no margin, no rounding slack above that ceiling - and the percentage allowance introduced by PLAN AMENDMENT RECORD A4 is DELETED from every governing clause of this plan, not merely superseded.

**OUT (deliberately not in this plan):**

- The content of the generated READMEs (they are produced by `scripts/generate-docs`; this plan only removes them from the indexed corpus).
- Any change to the 13 handwritten example READMEs, to `README.md`, `STYLEGUIDE.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- Any new plan-log family, any new tracker file, any new `plans/**` log convention. READ WITH PLAN AMENDMENT RECORD A8: this item forbids a NEW workstream boundary and a NEW log family. IT DOES NOT FORBID THE SAME-BOUNDARY COMPANION LOG OF THIS VERY WORKSTREAM (`plans/cortex-plan-first-retrieval.logs.md`), WHICH THE CORPUS CONTRACT ALREADY PRESERVES INSIDE THE `plan` FAMILY WITH NO NEW LOG FAMILY (the house precedent is `plans/neatracing-voxel-racer.logs.md`).
- Any change to the embedding model, the chunker, the reranker or the retrieval algorithms beyond the family filter and the family priority - EXCEPT the BOUNDED-MEMORY REMEDIATION OF THE CHUNKER, admitted by PLAN AMENDMENT RECORD A6 and owned by the slice `P1-S3-4` (the never-released ts-morph AST and the whole-build ts-chunk Map): that remediation changes NO chunking RULE and NO chunking OUTPUT (the produced ts-source chunk records are byte-identical), and it exists ONLY to bring the resident set under the ALREADY-FROZEN peak-RSS ceiling of 585,711,616 bytes. It is NOT a chunker-behaviour change and it relaxes NO bound of this plan.
- The implementation of any of the above - this authoring pass wrote plan bytes only.

**The invariants that the contract must make observable:**

- I1 - no generated README is indexed (the 173 `src` READMEs and the 58 generated example READMEs).
- I2 - every handwritten document stays indexed (the `root-doc` family plus the 13 handwritten example READMEs).

- I4 - exactly the existing test documents are reclassified into `test`; no test document is dropped and no new test document is authored by the reclassification.
- I5 - the 20.9 MB snapshot is not indexed.
- I6 - the corpus change does not increase the peak heap / peak RSS of the build, nor the indexed corpus bytes, nor the replica size. RESTATED BY PLAN AMENDMENT RECORD A5 - the peak-RSS half of this invariant is the MEDIAN of N >= 5 post-change runs of the SAME probe, and that MEDIAN MUST NOT exceed the ORIGINALLY FROZEN ceiling of 585,711,616 bytes, with NO allowance of any kind (no percentage, no tolerance band, no margin, no rounding slack; the A4 percentage allowance is DELETED); the corpus-bytes and replica-size halves are unchanged.

## Implementation phases

### Phase 1 — The corpus contract: deterministic families, no generated noise, bounded memory [DONE]

**Phase objective:** ONE published corpus-family contract, the target family set (the `readme` and `benchmark` families retired, the `test` family added, the generated READMEs and the session snapshot excluded), and the bounded-memory proof for the `rag:update` pipeline.

**Phase progression rule (CLOSED):** Phase 1 closed on the USER directive of the A8 compression pass. Its phase packet, its three step packets, the whole evidence body and the nine archived fix packets were compressed into the SAME-BOUNDARY companion log `plans/cortex-plan-first-retrieval.logs.md` (the PER-PHASE COMPRESSION RULE and the PHASE COMPRESSION POLICY of the `tracker-handoff` skill). This plan keeps the phase header, the goal, the status and this coverage note; the log keeps the byte-exact packets. NOTHING WAS DELETED.

      fixture_discipline: 'NO FIXTURE FILE IS CREATED, REGENERATED OR RE-PINNED BY THIS LANE. THE CORPUS LANES DRIVE THE EXISTING `search_corpus` MCP TOOL OVER THE EXISTING LIVE INDEX; THERE IS NO MOCK OF THE SQL, NO STUB OF THE CLASSIFIER AND NO IMPORT OF A MODULE THAT DOES NOT EXIST YET. THE NEW DENSE HOME `rag-index/__tests__/query-dense-family-set.red.test.mjs` MOCKS **ONLY THE DB CLIENT** - IT USES THE **REAL** `rag-index/query-dense.mjs` AND THE **REAL** `rag-index/metadata-filter.mjs` - AND IT INJECTS `embedText` AND `modelMeta` SO NO ONNX MODEL IS LOADED, NO LIVE INDEX IS NEEDED, AND THERE IS NO RNG, NO CLOCK AND NO NETWORK. THE ONLY THREE QUERIES ARE MODULE-LEVEL STRING CONSTANTS. DISCLOSED SIDE EFFECT: DRIVING THE REAL TOOL RECORDS SEARCH-IMPRESSION ROWS IN THE LIVE INDEX (`recordSearchImpressions`); THIS IS THE REPOSITORY OWN REGISTERED MACHINERY, DISCLOSED AND NOT SUPPRESSED.'
      lane_design_notes: 'THE ROUTED FAMILY SET IS READ FROM THE ROUTING TABLE (`rag-index/routing-table.mjs:103` -> `ROUTING.plan_specific.family = "plan,completed-plan"`) AND IS NOT RE-TYPED IN THE HOME, so THE HOME FOLLOWS THE ROUTING IF THE ROUTING CHANGES. THE TWO FALLBACK FLAGS ARE ASSERTED THROUGH A DISJUNCTION (`broadenReported()`) OVER THE TWO EXISTING FLAGS (`family_fallback` / `classification_fallback`) BECAUSE NO SLICE-LEVEL CRITERION NAMES A DEDICATED FLAG: THE IMPLEMENTER MAY REPORT THE BROADEN THROUGH EITHER EXISTING FLAG, AND A NEW DEDICATED FLAG WOULD REQUIRE A RE-PIN BY `P2-S4-4` (WHICH OWNS THIS FILE). THE NOTHING-ANYWHERE LANE PINS THE ROUTED FAMILY EXPLICITLY (`query_class: "plan_specific"` PLUS `classification_hints.family = <the routed CSV>`) BECAUSE THE ROUTING KEYWORD MATCHER WOULD OTHERWISE REACH THE PLAN ROUTE ONLY THROUGH AN ACCIDENTAL SUBSTRING INSIDE THE QUERY TEXT; THE PIN DOES NOT SUPPRESS THE BROADEN-ON-EMPTY NET (THE NET FIRES ON `!("family" in options)`, AND THE HINT IS A SEPARATE CHANNEL), WHICH IS EXACTLY THE BEHAVIOUR THE LANE MUST OBSERVE. THE GREEN GUARD LANE (`planFamilyRowCount > 0`) EXISTS BECAUSE LANES 1, 2 AND 5 ARE OTHERWISE SATISFIABLE BY AN EMPTY RESULT SET. **A13 ADDITION (THE REOPENED LANE):** THE NEW DENSE HOME `rag-index/__tests__/query-dense-family-set.red.test.mjs` REPLACES THE MOCKED MODULE WITH THE REAL ONE FOR `rag-index/metadata-filter.mjs`, MOCKS ONLY THE DB CLIENT, AND INJECTS `embedText` / `modelMeta` / `dimension` SO THE LANE IS OFFLINE AND DETERMINISTIC; THE FAMILY IS READ FROM THE ROUTING TABLE, NOT RE-TYPED; THE HOME ASSERTS A PARAMETERIZED SET PREDICATE WITH **ONE BOUND PARAMETER PER FAMILY** AT ALL THREE DENSE SQL SITES (`rag-index/query-dense.mjs:199`, `:309`, `:372`), AND IT CARRIES A GREEN ANTI-VACUITY LANE (NO FAMILY -> NO FAMILY PREDICATE; ONE FAMILY -> THE UNCHANGED `d.doc_family = ?` WITH EXACTLY ONE BOUND PARAMETER). THE OWNER-LOCAL HOME `rag-index/query-dense.test.mjs` IS THE SECOND OWNED FILE: ITS MOCK FACTORY AT `:55-58` MUST EXPOSE `compileFamilySetFilter` (THE PREFERRED ROUTE IS TO CAPTURE THE REAL MODULE BEFORE THE MOCK REGISTRATION AND RE-EXPOSE THE REAL FUNCTION; THE PERMITTED FALLBACK IS A FAITHFUL MIRROR OF `rag-index/metadata-filter.mjs:802-821`), BECAUSE A DROPPED EXPORT MAKES THE SOURCE IMPORT `undefined` AND TURNS THE SIX DIRECT FAMILY LANES PLUS THE ONE TRANSITIVE LANE OF THAT HOME INTO A `TypeError` FAILURE - MEASURED BY THE TIER-3 `implementation-pattern-scout` DISPATCHED IN THIS A13 ACT. **THE REOPENED LANE TOOK THE PREFERRED ROUTE:** THE MOCK FACTORY OF `rag-index/query-dense.test.mjs` CAPTURES THE REAL `./metadata-filter.mjs` **BEFORE** THE MOCK REGISTRATION AND RE-EXPOSES THE REAL `compileFamilySetFilter` THROUGH A DELEGATING `jest.fn` SPY - THE PERMITTED FALLBACK (A FAITHFUL MIRROR OF `rag-index/metadata-filter.mjs:802-821`) WAS **NOT** NEEDED. **THE EXPECTED CONTRACT IN THE NEW DENSE HOME IS DERIVED, NOT RE-TYPED:** THE EXPECTED PREDICATE AND THE EXPECTED BOUND VALUES ARE COMPILED BY THE **REAL** `compileFamilySetFilter` AT TEST TIME, SO THE HOME MEASURES THE PRODUCTION SQL AGAINST THE REAL HELPER RATHER THAN AGAINST A HAND-WRITTEN STRING. THE FAMILY IS READ FROM THE ROUTING TABLE AND NEVER RE-TYPED. THE THREE DENSE SITES ARE REACHED THROUGH THE OWNER-LOCAL MOCK PATTERN (BM25-ONLY -> CALL 0; DENSE ANN -> CALL 1; BRUTE-FORCE -> CALL 2, WITH THE ANN CALL REJECTED SO THE PATH FALLS THROUGH) AND THE HOME ASSERTS THE CALL COUNT IS EXACTLY 3, SO A SILENT PATH CHANGE CANNOT VACUATE A LANE. **DISCLOSED RISK (NOT ABSORBED):** THE DERIVED EXPECTED PREDICATE CARRIES THE `d.` TABLE ALIAS THAT THE REAL HELPER EMITS, SO A LEGITIMATE IMPLEMENTATION THAT WRITES AN EQUIVALENT SET PREDICATE **WITHOUT** THAT ALIAS WOULD STILL FAIL THIS HOME - THE ESCAPE HATCH IS AN **OWNER-APPROVED** UPDATE OF THE RED HOME BY `P2-S4-4` (WHICH OWNS IT), NOT A SILENT WEAKENING BY `P2-S4-2`.'

      measured_baseline: 'MEASURED ON THE WORKING TREE BY THE ORCHESTRATOR AND RE-DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY BY THE TIER-3 `slice-validator` (ALL FOUR FACTS ARE BYTE-EXACT): (1) THE PUBLISHED PRIORITY IS `["ts-source","readme","plan","agent","skill","demo"]` - THE SOURCE FAMILY IS FIRST, THE RETIRED `readme` FAMILY IS SECOND AND THE PLAN FAMILY IS THIRD; (2) `completed-plan` IS **ABSENT** FROM THE PUBLISHED PRIORITY, SO ITS PRODUCTION ORDINAL IS `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` (`rag-index/assemble-context.mjs:375-380`); (3) AT AN EQUAL SCORE AND DIFFERENT FILE PATHS, `orderChunks` RETURNS THE **SOURCE** CHUNK FIRST - THE FAMILY DELTA IS A TIE-BREAK AFTER THE TIER DELTA AND THE FILE-MAX DELTA AND IT OUTRANKS THE FILE-PATH FALLBACK; (4) THE ADVANCED-SEARCH MODULE STILL DECLARES `README_FAMILY = "readme"` (`:84`), `GENERATED_README_FAMILY = "generated-readme"` (`:85`) AND FILTERS ON BOTH (`:857-863`, COMPARISONS AT `:860-861`).       fixture_discipline: 'NO FIXTURE FILE IS CREATED, REGENERATED OR RE-PINNED BY THIS LANE. THE HOME MOBS NOTHING: IT IMPORTS THE **REAL** `DEFAULT_FAMILY_PRIORITY` AND THE **REAL** `orderChunks` FROM `rag-index/assemble-context.mjs` (WHICH IMPORTS ONLY `node:crypto`), THE **REAL** `CORPUS_FAMILY_NAMES` FROM `rag-index/corpus-sources.mjs` AND THE **REAL** ROUTING TABLE, AND IT READS `scripts/mcp-semantic/tools/search-advanced.mjs` **AS TEXT THROUGH `node:fs` - THE MODULE IS NEVER IMPORTED**, BECAUSE THE `rag-index-mjs` JEST PROJECT HAS NO SETUP FILE WHILE THE `mcp-semantic-mjs` ONE EXISTS PRECISELY TO FORCE THE DENSE AND RERANKER STATES TO `cold` "without loading onnxruntime-node native bindings, which can crash during Jest teardown". THERE IS NO RNG, NO CLOCK, NO NETWORK, NO LIVE INDEX AND NO DATABASE. THE TWO ORDERING FIXTURES ARE INLINE LITERAL CHUNK OBJECTS WITH A FIXED SCORE, A FIXED FAMILY AND A FIXED FILE PATH.'
      lane_design_notes: 'THE FAMILY NAMES ARE **DERIVED, NOT RE-TYPED**: THE SOURCE FAMILY COMES FROM `ROUTING.code_specific.family` AND THE PLAN FAMILIES FROM `ROUTING.plan_specific.family` (THE CSV `plan,completed-plan`), SO THE HOME FOLLOWS THE ROUTING IF THE ROUTING CHANGES. THE `completed-plan` LANE USES A DOCUMENTED LOCAL HELPER (`priorityOrdinalOf`) THAT **MIRRORS THE PRODUCTION ORDINAL RULE** OF `familyPriorityOrdinal` (`rag-index/assemble-context.mjs:375-380`): A FAMILY **ABSENT** FROM THE LIST SORTS LAST. A RAW `indexOf` WOULD RETURN `-1` FOR AN ABSENT FAMILY AND WOULD MAKE THE COMPARISON **VACUOUSLY GREEN** TODAY, SO THE MIRROR IS WHAT MAKES THAT LANE A GENUINE MEASUREMENT. THE HEAD-OF-LIST LANE COMPARES **SET-WISE** (`head.toSorted()` AGAINST `[...PLAN_FAMILIES].toSorted()`), SO IT PINS "THE PLAN FAMILIES AT THE HEAD" - THE STEP-LEVEL `AC-402` AND `AC-402-B` REQUIREMENT - **WITHOUT** PINNING THE INTERNAL ORDER OF THE TWO PLAN FAMILIES OR THE LITERAL LIST. THE SERIAL `rag-index` SWEEP MEASURED **EXIT 1 WITH EXACTLY ONE FAILING SUITE - THE NEW RED HOME ITSELF** - AND THE `scripts/mcp-semantic` SWEEP MEASURED **EXIT 0, 66/66 SUITES**. **THE PARALLEL `rag-index` SWEEP INTERMITTENTLY ALSO FAILS `rag-index/auto-reindex.test.mjs` (MEASURED TWICE IN THIS LANE, ON TWO OF THREE PARALLEL RUNS), AND THAT IS THE ALREADY-DOCUMENTED `V-OBS-064` PARALLEL-ONLY FLAKE, NOT A REGRESSION AND NOT A PRODUCT OF THIS LANE.** THE PROOF IS FOURFOLD AND MEASURED: (a) THE SERIAL SWEEP MEASURED **PASS** FOR THAT SUITE (`PASS rag-index-mjs rag-index/auto-reindex.test.mjs`); (b) THE SUITE PASSES **12/12 IN ISOLATION**; (c) ITS CHANGED-FILE DISCOVERY USES `git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD` (`rag-index/auto-reindex.mjs:152`) - **THE LAST COMMIT DIFF, NOT THE WORKING TREE** - SO IT **CANNOT SEE** A WORKING-TREE FILE, INCLUDING THE ONE FILE THIS LANE CREATED; AND (d) THE PLAN ALREADY NAMES THE **SERIAL** SWEEP AS THE DETERMINISTIC BASELINE AND ALREADY RECORDS THIS EXACT FLAKE CLASS (`V-OBS-064`, `SQLITE_BUSY`).'

      validation_side_effects: 'THE DECLARED `scripts/mcp-semantic` SWEEP RUNS THE RED CONTRACT HOME `scripts/mcp-semantic/__tests__/plan-first-live.red.test.mjs`, AND THAT HOME WRITES `artifacts/slice-P2-S6-1-live-response.json` WITH `writeFileSync` AT `:357` INSIDE ITS OWN `beforeAll` - **SO THE ARTEFACT IS REWRITTEN ON EVERY RUN, PASS OR FAIL.** THE ARTEFACT WAS MEASURED AT **11,876 BYTES, SHA-256 `c3d2b28acf727365992630daaadd9f37d031087bcb5c74a67c7b1c107eb091c8`, MTIME 2026-11-17T14:15:49Z** BEFORE THE SWEEP AND AT **13,091 BYTES, SHA-256 `8b0b858ba2d6609263971b82dd82ed04c6dda7e7bf83f30b276dbfa927c19e06`, MTIME 2026-11-17T15:54:34Z** AFTER IT - **THE SWEEP OVERWROTE IT, 17 SECONDS BEFORE `NOW_UTC` 2026-11-17T15:54:51Z.** THE ARTEFACT IS GITIGNORED (`.gitignore:95`), SO GIT SHOWS NO CHANGE AND **THE PRIOR BYTES ARE NOT RECOVERABLE** (MUTATING GIT IS BANNED). THE LIVE INDEX `rag-index/data/turso-replica.sqlite` (1,042,571,264 BYTES) WAS REWRITTEN AT THE SAME SECOND BY THE SAME CHAIN. **CONSEQUENCE FOR THE READER: THE CLAIM IN `stale_artefact_disclosure` THAT THIS LANE DID NOT OVERWRITE THE ARTEFACT WAS TRUE AT MEASUREMENT TIME AND IS NOW FALSIFIED BY THE DECLARED VALIDATION COMMAND THIS LANE RAN; THE CORRECTED STATEMENT IS THAT THE ARTEFACT WAS NOT OVERWRITTEN BY HAND AND WAS OVERWRITTEN BY THE `scripts/mcp-semantic` SWEEP THIS LANE RAN.** THE RED HOME ITSELF WAS NOT EDITED - IT MEASURED **23,096 BYTES, SHA-256 `2a585e2eaf723eefd4d11a91d4dd6f02f23cb235bb9c4e7e19547b9e9450e9c7`, MTIME 2026-11-17T14:02:22Z** BEFORE AND AFTER THIS ACT. **NO SOURCE, TEST, FIXTURE, SPEC, CONFIG, SQL OR TRACKED CORPUS BYTE WAS WRITTEN BY THIS LANE BY HAND; THE ONLY WRITES OUTSIDE THE THREE OWNED FILES WERE MADE BY THE DECLARED VALIDATION COMMANDS THEMSELVES - THE GITIGNORED ARTEFACT, THE LIVE INDEX AND THE DERIVED INDEX ARTEFACTS (`rag-index/data/corpus-hash.json`, `rag-index/data/freshness-manifest.json`, `rag-index/data/neataptic.db`).**'
      root_cause_and_ownership: 'THE ROOT-CAUSE SITE IS `rag-index/tokenizer.mjs`, AND IT IS **OWNED BY NO SLICE IN THIS PLAN**: NO `Step 06` SLICE OWNS IT AND NO OPEN SLICE OWNS IT. `sanitizeFtsQuery` (`:143`) PREFIXES EVERY PLAIN WORD WITH `*` (`:107-111` `formatToken`), AND `chunks_fts` IS AN FTS5 EXTERNAL-CONTENT TABLE OVER `chunks` WITH `content_rowid = chunk_id` AND `tokenize = porter unicode61` (`rag-index/schema-turso.sql:66-72`), WHICH **ANDS BAREWORDS IMPLICITLY** - SO A LONG NATURAL-LANGUAGE QUERY DEMANDS EVERY TOKEN IN ONE CHUNK AND THE `plan` FAMILY HAS NO SUCH CHUNK. **THE FAMILY FILTER IS NOT THE DEFECT:** THE BM25 PATH COMPILES THE ROUTED SET CORRECTLY (`scripts/mcp-semantic/tools/search-corpus.mjs:1387` -> `compileFamilySetFilter(family)` -> `d.doc_family IN (?, ?)`) AND THE DENSE PATH DOES SO AT `rag-index/query-dense.mjs:200`, `:309` AND `:366`. THE SET IS APPLIED; THE PLAN FAMILY SIMPLY HAS NO CHUNK HOLDING ALL THE TOKENS, SO THE BROADEN-ON-EMPTY NET FIRES AND THE BROADENED RESPONSE IS ADOPTED WITH BOTH FALLBACK FLAGS AND `ts-source` ROWS ON TOP (`scripts/mcp-semantic/tools/search-corpus.mjs:925-949`). **THIS LANE NAMED THE SITE; IT DID NOT FIX IT AND IT OWNS NO FILE THAT COULD.**'
      stale_artefact_disclosure: 'THE ARTEFACT `artifacts/slice-P2-S6-1-live-response.json` (11,876 BYTES, SHA-256 `c3d2b28acf727365992630daaadd9f37d031087bcb5c74a67c7b1c107eb091c8`, MTIME 2026-11-17T14:15:49Z, GITIGNORED AT `.gitignore:95`) **STILL RECORDS THE PRE-FIX MEASUREMENT** - THE CANONICAL QUERY AS `family_fallback: true` AND `classification_fallback: true` WITH THE TWO `ts-source` ROWS - WHICH CONTRADICTS THE LIVE MEASUREMENT IN THIS BLOCK. **THIS LANE DID NOT OVERWRITE IT AND DID NOT USE IT AS EVIDENCE:** THE RED HOME WRITES IT IN ITS OWN `beforeAll`, SO IT IS THE OWNED OUTPUT OF THE RED LANE AND NOT AN INDEPENDENT WITNESS. **IT MUST BE REGENERATED BY `P2-S6-3`,** WHICH OWNS THE RED HOME AND THEREFORE OWNS THE WRITE THAT PRODUCES IT. **THIS LANE MINTED NO OBSERVATION ID FOR THE FACT - `V-OBS-071` IS THE EXISTING HOME.** **AND THE CLAUSE "THIS LANE DID NOT OVERWRITE IT" ABOVE WAS TRUE AT MEASUREMENT TIME AND WAS FALSIFIED BY THE DECLARED `scripts/mcp-semantic` SWEEP THIS LANE RAN - SEE `validation_side_effects` AND `### THE P2-S6-2 POST-WRITE MEASUREMENT AND VALIDATION-SIDE-EFFECT RECORD`.       stale_publication_correction: 'THE CLAIM "THE FOUR RESIDUAL `V-OBS` OBLIGATIONS RAISED BY THE `Step 04` CLOSURE (`V-OBS-065`, `V-OBS-067`, `V-OBS-068`, `V-OBS-070`) REMAIN OPEN AND UNOWNED" WAS **STALE FOR `V-OBS-065`** AND IS CORRECTED IN BOTH `plans/README.md` AND IN `plans/Roadmap.md` BY `M-2`: `V-OBS-065` IS RE-SCOPED TO A DO-NOT-REGRESS OBLIGATION PINNED BY `AC-401-A2` (`P2-S4-1`) AND `AC-401-GREEN` (`P2-S4-4`), AND ITS IMPLEMENTATION SUBJECT - THE `AC-405` BROADEN REPORTING - IS DISCHARGED IN FACT IN THE WORKING TREE. `V-OBS-067`, `V-OBS-068` AND `V-OBS-070` ARE UNCHANGED AND REMAIN OPEN AND UNOWNED. **THE HISTORICAL TRACKER PROSE IS ANNOTATED AND IS NOT REWRITTEN** - SIX TRACKER LOCI CARRY THE ANNOTATION: POINT 8 OF THE `P2-S6-1` EXECUTION RECORD (WHICH IS INSIDE THE BYTE-EXACT ARCHIVE REGION `P2-S6-1-EXECUTION-RECORD` AND THEREFORE CARRIES ITS ANNOTATION OUT OF PLACE, IN THE `P2-S6-1` CLOSURE GATE EVIDENCE BLOCK, SO THE REGION STAYS BYTE-FOR-BYTE EQUAL TO THE COMPANION LOG), SUB-POINT (6) OF POINT 11 OF THAT BLOCK, POINT 13 OF THAT BLOCK, THE `V-OBS-065` BULLET OF THE `P2-S4-2` HANDOFF REFRESH, THE "THE FOUR RESIDUAL `V-OBS` OBLIGATIONS" BULLET OF THE `Step 06` ACTIVATION HANDOFF REFRESH AND THE "THE OPEN OBLIGATIONS THAT MUST NOT BE ABSORBED" BULLET OF THE `P2-S6-1` HANDOFF REFRESH.'
      not_touched: '**THE RED CONTRACT HOME `scripts/mcp-semantic/__tests__/plan-first-live.red.test.mjs` IS NOT EDITED BY THIS LANE.** IT MEASURED 23,096 BYTES WITH SHA-256 `2a585e2eaf723eefd4d11a91d4dd6f02f23cb235bb9c4e7e19547b9e9450e9c7` AND MTIME 2026-11-17T14:02:22Z BEFORE THIS ACT AND **THE SAME THREE FIGURES AFTER THIS ACT**. `P2-S6-3` OWNS IT AND IT MUST STILL BE RED WHEN THE GREEN LANE RUNS. **NO SOURCE, TEST, FIXTURE, SPEC, CONFIG, SQL OR CORPUS BYTE WAS WRITTEN BY THIS LANE,** AND NO MUTATING GIT COMMAND WAS RUN - INSPECTION ONLY. THE FIVE BOUNDED-MEMORY SAMPLES BUILT INTO TEMPORARY DATABASES AND REPORTED `liveIndexUntouched: true` IN ALL FIVE RUNS, SO THE LIVE INDEX WAS NEVER REWRITTEN BY THE MEASUREMENT. **THIS CLAUSE IS STILL TRUE AS SCOPED TO THE MEASUREMENT, AND IT MUST NOT BE READ AS A CLAIM THAT THE LIVE INDEX WAS NEVER REWRITTEN DURING THIS ACT: THE DECLARED `scripts/mcp-semantic` SWEEP REBUILT THE LIVE INDEX `rag-index/data/turso-replica.sqlite` AT 2026-11-17T15:54:34Z - SEE `validation_side_effects`.**'
      disclosed_not_absorbed: '(1) **THE REACH DEFECT IS LIVE AND IS NOT ABSORBED** - `V-OBS-071` STAYS OPEN AND UNOWNED AND `rag-index/tokenizer.mjs` STILL HAS NO OWNING SLICE. (2) **THE OWNING LANE IS STILL A TIER-0 DECISION** AND IT STILL GATES `P2-S6-3`. (3) **THE STALE ARTEFACT IS STILL STALE** - SEE ABOVE. (4) **`V-OBS-067`, `V-OBS-068` AND `V-OBS-070` REMAIN OPEN AND UNOWNED** AND ARE NOT ABSORBED. (5) **`V-OBS-064`** (THE PARALLEL-SWEEP CONTENTION FLAKE - THE SERIAL SWEEP IS THE NAMED DETERMINISTIC BASELINE), **`V-OBS-021`** (THE STANDING ENVIRONMENT CAVEAT) AND **`V-OBS-060`** (THE `+1` COMPANION LOG) ARE UNCHANGED. (6) **THIS LANE MINTS NO OBSERVATION ID, CREATES NO SLICE, DELETES NO ACCEPTANCE CRITERION, ADDS NO FIX-LOOP MARKER AND FLIPS NO SLICE STATUS.** (7) **THE FRESH QUERY MEASURED IN THIS BLOCK BECOMES A QUOTED QUERY FOR EVERY LATER CORPUS** ONCE THIS BLOCK IS INDEXED, SO THE FRESH-QUERY FIGURES ARE **PRE-WRITE** MEASUREMENTS AND THE SAME QUERY MUST NOT BE READ AS A STILL-GREEN OR STILL-RED FIXTURE AFTER THIS ACT - THAT IS EXACTLY THE CORPUS-COINCIDENCE ARTEFACT THAT `V-OBS-071` DESCRIBES.       handoff: '**THE NEXT LANE IS `P2-S6-3` (`05-green-testing`).** IN ONE SENTENCE: RUN THE GREEN LANE OVER THE THREE RED HOMES OF THE LANE, PROVE THEY ARE GREEN BY NAME, AND **DO NOT TREAT THE CANONICAL FIXTURE GREEN AS PROOF** - THE FRESH, NEVER-QUOTED PLAN-SHAPED QUERY MEASURED IN THIS ACT STILL REPRODUCES THE FAILURE SIGNATURE, SO THE CANONICAL GREEN IS A CORPUS COINCIDENCE. **THE RED CONTRACT HOME `scripts/mcp-semantic/__tests__/plan-first-live.red.test.mjs` MUST NOT BE EDITED BY ANY IMPLEMENTING LANE, AND THE STALE ARTEFACT MUST BE REGENERATED BY THE OWNED `P2-S6-3` HOME ITSELF.** **THE OWNING LANE FOR THE REACH DEFECT AT `rag-index/tokenizer.mjs` IS STILL A TIER-0 DECISION AND IT STILL GATES THIS LANE.** `Step 06` STAYS `[WIP]` AND `P2-S6-2` STAYS `[WIP]` - **THIS LANE FLIPS NEITHER.**'

THE VERDICT #19 DE-DUPLICATION ALTERNATIVE WAS CONSIDERED AND **REJECTED**: IT DELETES LIVE COVERAGE FROM A FIRST-CLASS `rag-index/__tests__/` HOME INSTEAD OF RE-PINNING IT, AND THE SIBLING HOME IS SELECTED BY THE GREEN LANE`S OWN COMMAND `npm run jest:mjs -- --testPathPatterns="rag-index"` - EIGHT SIBLING HOMES IN THAT DIRECTORY RAN IN THE SAME MEASURED SWEEP - SO IT IS A LIVE, FIRST-CLASS HOME AND NOT A LEGACY LEFTOVER.'
      - id: 'M-3 (the boundary is three files - the Tier-0 boundary amendment required by M-A1 IS MADE HERE, and no fourth file is silently taken)'
        text: '`scripts/mcp-semantic/tools/search-corpus.mjs` IS OWNED BY THE `[DONE]` SLICE `P2-S4-2` AND MUST NOT BE EDITED BY THIS SLICE; `rag-index/query-index.mjs` IS THE SUBJECT OF THE OPEN AND UNOWNED `V-OBS-067` AND `rag-index/metadata-filter.mjs` IS THE SUBJECT OF THE OPEN AND UNOWNED `V-OBS-070`, AND NEITHER IS ABSORBED HERE. THE THIRD FILE `rag-index/__tests__/tokenizer.test.mjs` WAS ADDED BY THE TIER-0 AMENDING PLAN ACT OF 2026-11-17 THAT APPLIED VERIFICATION VERDICT #19 `M-A1` - THE `P2-S5-2` BOUNDARY-AMENDMENT PRECEDENT - AND THAT AMENDMENT IS RECORDED HERE, NOT HIDDEN: THE BOUNDARY IS NOW EXACTLY THREE FILES, AND **NO FOURTH FILE MAY BE ADDED WITHOUT ANOTHER TIER-0 PLAN ACT.** THE FROZEN BOUNDED-MEMORY FIXTURE `rag-index/__tests__/fixtures/build-memory-baseline.json` IS NOT REGENERATED AND THE LIVE INDEX IS NOT REBUILT BY HAND. **AMENDED BY THE TIER-0 PLAN ACT OF THIS SESSION - THE FIX-LOOP OPENING ACT - UNDER THE VERBATIM TIER-0 DIRECTIVE `Open P2-S6-4 fix loop for its two regressions; preserve N=3.`: THE WRITE SET OF `P2-S6-4` NOW ALSO CARRIES THE TWO OUT-OF-BOUNDARY FIXTURE HOMES `scripts/mcp-semantic/tools/search-corpus.direct.test.mjs` AND `scripts/mcp-semantic/__tests__/plan-family-filter.red.test.mjs`, WHICH ARE THE TWO HOMES THAT THE `M-4` THRESHOLD-GATED JOIN TURNED RED.       - id: 'M-4 (the join resolution is SETTLED - the threshold-gated join with N = 3 - the red contract must encode THIS and not another)'
        text: 'THE JOIN RESOLUTION IS DECIDED HERE AND THE `03-red-testing` LANE MUST ENCODE EXACTLY THIS: A **THRESHOLD-GATED JOIN**, NOT A UNIFORM NON-AND JOIN. `sanitizeFtsQuery` KEEPS THE IMPLICIT-AND SPACE-JOIN AT OR BELOW **N = 3** TOKENS AND OR-JOINS THE TOKENS WITH THE UPPERCASE FTS5 KEYWORD `OR` AT **4 OR MORE** TOKENS. **N = 3 IS THE PINNED VALUE** AND IT IS THE LOWEST VALUE THAT PRESERVES EVERY EXISTING PIN IN BOTH HOMES: THE LONGEST EXACT MULTI-TOKEN PIN IN EITHER HOME IS **3** TOKENS (`NEAT selection code` IN THE OWNER-LOCAL HOME AT `:49` AND IN THE SIBLING HOME AT `:81`, AND `network.activate NEAT selection` IN THE SIBLING HOME AT `:85`), SO AT OR BELOW 3 TOKENS THE EMITTED EXPRESSION IS **BYTE-IDENTICAL TO TODAY`S SPACE-JOIN** AND EVERY EXISTING PIN IN BOTH HOMES STAYS GREEN UNCHANGED. A UNIFORM NON-AND JOIN WAS **REJECTED**: IT BREAKS BOTH HOMES` MULTI-TOKEN PINS AND MAKES THE `AC-403-B` CLAUSE "THE TOKEN COUNT OF A MIXED PHRASE IS PRESERVED" UNSATISFIABLE AS WRITTEN, WHICH WOULD HAVE REQUIRED AMENDING THE CRITERION.'
      - id: 'M-5 (the three-file write set is ABSORBED - the slice is NOT split and the four-hour ceiling holds)'
        text: 'THE `estimate_hours: 4` CEILING PROBLEM NAMED BY VERIFICATION VERDICT #19 CHECK 5 IS DECIDED BY ABSORPTION, **NOT** BY SPLITTING: `estimate_hours` STAYS **4** AND THE SLICE IS **NOT** SPLIT.       measured_baseline: 'MEASURED ON THE WORKING TREE BY THE ORCHESTRATOR, IN THIS ACT, OVER THE UNMODIFIED `rag-index/tokenizer.mjs`: (1) `sanitizeFtsQuery` TODAY **ALWAYS** SPACE-JOINS ITS TOKENS, SO THE EMITTED MATCH EXPRESSION IS AN IMPLICIT-AND OVER BAREWORDS IN FTS5 AND A LONG PLAN-SHAPED QUERY DEMANDS THAT EVERY TOKEN CO-OCCUR IN ONE CHUNK - THE `V-OBS-071` FACT (D) ROOT CAUSE; (2) TODAY THE EMITTED EXPRESSION FOR THE CANONICAL 11-TOKEN PLAN-SHAPED QUERY IS `"how* should* the* network* activation* runtime* be* specified* in* the* plan*"` AND THE EXPECTED REPAIRED FORM IS `"how* OR should* OR the* OR network* OR activation* OR runtime* OR be* OR specified* OR in* OR the* OR plan*"`; (3) TODAY A USER TOKEN THAT IS EXACTLY `AND`, `OR` OR `NOT` TAKES THE ACRONYM PATH AND IS EMITTED BARE (`"AND"`, `"OR"`, `"NOT"` ARE THE EXPECTED QUOTED FORMS), SO A RESERVED KEYWORD IS INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM A JOIN OPERATOR; (4) THE LIVE PIPELINE DELEGATES TO THIS ONE IMPLEMENTATION - `scripts/mcp-semantic/tools/cortex-db.mjs:287-289` RE-EXPORTS `sanitizeFtsQuery` AS A THIN WRAPPER OVER `import { sanitizeFtsQuery as sanitizeFtsQueryImpl } from "../../../rag-index/tokenizer.mjs"` - **SO FIXING `rag-index/tokenizer.mjs` FIXES THE LIVE SEARCH PATH AND NO FOURTH FILE IS NEEDED, WHICH HOLDS THE `M-3` BOUNDARY**; (5) A THIRD, INDEPENDENT IMPLEMENTATION EXISTS AT `examples/neatChat/memory/neatChat.memory.fts.ts:10` AND IS **OUTSIDE THE SLICE BOUNDARY AND UNTOUCHED** - IT IS DISCLOSED, NOT ABSORBED; (6) THE REPO-WIDE BLAST RADIUS OF THE `N = 3` THRESHOLD IS CLEAN: EVERY OTHER `sanitizeFtsQuery` PIN IN THE REPO IS AT MOST 3 TOKENS (`scripts/mcp-semantic/__tests__/sanitize-fts-query.red.test.mjs`, `scripts/mcp-semantic/__tests__/cortex-db.turso.test.mjs:291`, `scripts/mcp-semantic/__tests__/cortex-db.coverage.test.mjs:551-567`, `scripts/mcp-semantic/__tests__/cortex-db.direct.test.mjs:338` AND `rag-index/tokenizer.test.ts`), SO NO PIN OUTSIDE THESE TWO HOMES CAN BE RESHAPED BY THE FIX.'
      fixture_discipline: 'NO FIXTURE FILE IS CREATED, REGENERATED OR RE-PINNED BY THIS LANE.       lane_design_notes: 'THE LANE ENCODES EXACTLY THE `M-4` RESOLUTION AND NOT ANOTHER. (1) **THE THRESHOLD-GATED JOIN, `N = 3`:** AT OR BELOW THREE TOKENS THE EMITTED EXPRESSION IS BYTE-IDENTICAL TO TODAY`S SPACE-JOIN, AND AT FOUR OR MORE TOKENS THE TOKENS ARE JOINED WITH THE UPPERCASE FTS5 KEYWORD `OR` AND THE SEPARATOR IS EXACTLY `" OR "` - ONE SPACE, THE KEYWORD, ONE SPACE. THE JOIN IS PINNED EXACTLY AT THREE TOKENS (SPACE), FOUR TOKENS (OR), SIX TOKENS (THE `P2-S6-1` FIXTURE `design specification for network activation runtime`) AND ELEVEN TOKENS (THE CANONICAL `P2-S6-1` FIXTURE), SO THE GATE IS PINNED FROM BOTH SIDES AND THE RESOLUTION IS NOT RE-DERIVABLE BY THE IMPLEMENTING LANE. (2) **THE `M-4` RESERVED-KEYWORD CLAUSE:** A USER TOKEN THAT IS EXACTLY `AND`, `OR` OR `NOT` IS EMITTED AS A QUOTED PHRASE, PINNED IN THE SPACE-JOINED BAND, IN THE OR-JOINED BAND AND AS A STANDALONE SINGLE-TOKEN QUERY. (3) **THE TOKENISATION CONTRACT OF `AC-403-B` IS PRESERVED AND IS PINNED ACROSS THE JOIN, NOT ONLY BELOW IT:** THE `network.activate` DOTTED IDENTIFIER STAYS A QUOTED PHRASE AND THE `NEAT` ACRONYM STAYS AN EXACT TERM **WHILE THE QUERY IS OR-JOINED**, AND THE PLAIN WORDS KEEP THEIR PREFIX WILDCARD, SO THE PINNED TOKEN COUNT OF A MIXED PHRASE IS PRESERVED ABOVE THE THRESHOLD AS WELL AS BELOW IT. (4) **THE ANTI-VACUITY TRIO** (`alpha beta gamma` STAYS SPACE-JOINED, `or` STAYS A PLAIN WORD, `ANDROID` STAYS AN EXACT ACRONYM) STOPS THREE OVER-BROAD FIXES: OR-JOINING BELOW THE THRESHOLD, QUOTING RESERVED KEYWORDS CASE-INSENSITIVELY, AND QUOTING ANY TOKEN THAT MERELY STARTS WITH A RESERVED KEYWORD. (5) **THE RESIDUAL BAND IS DISCLOSED, NOT CLOSED:** A PLAN-SHAPED QUERY OF AT MOST THREE TOKENS STILL REQUIRES ONE CHUNK TO CARRY EVERY TOKEN AND IS **NOT** REPAIRED BY THIS SLICE, EXACTLY AS `M-4` STATES. (6) **THE FOURTH FTS5 RESERVED KEYWORD IS DISCLOSED, NOT SILENTLY WIDENED:** `NEAR` IS AN FTS5 RESERVED KEYWORD AND IS NEITHER ENUMERATED IN `M-4` NOR PINNED BY THIS CONTRACT, SO A BAREWORD `NEAR` REMAINS A PROXIMITY-OPERATOR HAZARD. **THIS LANE DID NOT ADD A `NEAR` PIN, BECAUSE `M-4` SETTLES THE RESERVED-KEYWORD SET AS EXACTLY `AND`, `OR` AND `NOT` AND WIDENING A SETTLED RESOLUTION IS NOT A RED-LANE ACT** - THE GAP IS RAISED FOR TIER-0 AND FOR THE IMPLEMENTING LANE INSTEAD. (7) **THE THREE EXISTING PINS AT `:49`, `:53` AND `:88` AND THE TWO SIBLING PINS AT `:81` AND `:85` WERE ALL AT MOST THREE TOKENS, SO THE `M-2` RE-PIN OBLIGATION OVER BOTH HOMES IS DISCHARGED BY MEASUREMENT AND THE SIBLING HOME NEEDED NO EDIT AND WAS NOT DE-DUPLICATED AWAY.**'

      lane_design_notes: 'THE THREE DESIGN DECISIONS, EACH DISCHARGING ONE CONTRACT CLAUSE. (1) **THE THRESHOLD GATE IS ON THE TOKEN COUNT, NOT ON THE CHARACTER COUNT**, SO THE PINNED TOKEN COUNT OF A MIXED PHRASE IS PRESERVED ACROSS THE JOIN AND NOT ONLY BELOW IT - A DOTTED IDENTIFIER STAYS A QUOTED PHRASE AND AN ACRONYM STAYS AN EXACT TERM **WHILE THE QUERY IS OR-JOINED**, AS `AC-403-B` REQUIRES. ## Validation gates

Step-level `validation` lists inside each packet are the authoritative per-step command
sources (MCP allowlist authority: `active-step.validation`). Consolidated gate routing:

- `slice-advancement` — consolidates plan-sync + step-packet + plan-slice-quality +
  plan-command-lint; run per active slice/step handoff. The Step-01 authoring pass is
  captured in `## Latest validation evidence` (the Phase-1 evidence body is archived
  byte-exact in the same-boundary companion log `plans/cortex-plan-first-retrieval.logs.md`).
- `cortex-index` — RAG freshness + workflow corpus MCP liveness; rerun after every
  tracker edit batch (see `rag-index/reindex-plan-family.mjs` + `build-index` +
  `validate-index` recovery loop).
- `agent-graph` — only after any agent delegation change. `learning-event` — only after
  discovering a workflow gap or improvement.
